about: A made-up stretch of talk for test/replay.test.mjs, written for the made-up show in stand-in-script.md: every name and line is invented. One piece per pause; expect names the prepared questions that fit what was just said (one of them must show on the card or in Relevant now); asked names the question the host then asks.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: So most people think a weekly copy is plenty.

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: Right, but a copy sitting on the same server is not a backup at all. When that server dies, the copy dies with it, and you only find out on the worst morning of the year.

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: And even a real backup somewhere else is only half the job. If you have never tried to restore it, you do not know whether it will restore, though everybody assumes it does.

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: That week began on a Monday. The first sign was one customer email saying the shop showed an empty page. I was away on holiday, and honestly nobody would have noticed for days.

lines.speaker: host
lines.text: People in the chat keep asking about plugins.

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: A backup plugin is fine as a start. I still want the host to keep one too, on its own systems, so one mistake never takes both.
